SELECT re.org_qual_val, re.surg_cmpl_val, re.surg_risk_val, re.res_avail_val, re.cntr_exp_val, re.cntr_vol_val, re.cntr_out_val, re.qol_val, re.cost_eff_val, re.alloc_prio_val
FROM risk_evaluation re 
JOIN transplant_matching tm ON re.risk_eval_registry = tm.match_rec_registry
WHERE tm.level_val = 'Marginal'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    tm.match_rec_registry AS match_id,
    tm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
    tm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
    ar.exp_rev_notes AS marginal_reason,
    re.org_qual_val,
    CASE 
        WHEN LOWER(c.med_urgency) = 'status 1a' THEN 5
        WHEN LOWER(c.med_urgency) = 'status 1b' THEN 4
        WHEN c.med_urgency = '2' THEN 3
        WHEN c.med_urgency = '3' THEN 2
        ELSE 1
    END AS medical_urgency_score,
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(c.wait_time, ' ', 1) AS INTEGER) / 365.0 AS wait_time_ratio,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(c.med_urgency) = 'status 1a' THEN 5
            WHEN LOWER(c.med_urgency) = 'status 1b' THEN 4
            WHEN c.med_urgency = '2' THEN 3
            WHEN c.med_urgency = '3' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END) * 0.7 + (CAST(SPLIT_PART(c.wait_time, ' ', 1) AS INTEGER) / 365.0) * 0.3
    AS numeric), 4) AS urgency_score
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN risk_evaluation re ON tm.match_rec_registry = re.risk_eval_registry
JOIN clinical c ON tm.recip_ref_reg = c.clin_recip_registry
JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
WHERE tm.level_val = 'Marginal'
ORDER BY urgency_score DESC;
